pretreatments.description: Mixing of whiskey byproducts (draff, thin stillage, and thick stillage) in a ratio of 1:7:6 based on wet weight
Steam pretreatment conducted in an autoclave at 135 °C for 15 min
Dilute sulfuric acid (H2SO4) pretreatment with a final concentration of 2% v/v conducted in an autoclave at 135 °C for 15 min
pH adjustment using 1 M NaOH solution to reach a value of 6.5–7.0 after heat/acid treatment
